# Managing Sponsored Researchers {.unnumbered}

As a Databrary Authorized Investigator, you can sponsor your students, research staff, and post-doctoral researchers who conduct research under your supervision.

For more information about who can be your sponsored researcher, see [this section](/getting-authorized/sponsored-researchers.qmd).

::: {.callout-important}
You should not be responsible for the use of Databrary by another individual who qualifies for Authorized Investigator status at their home institution. They are responsible for seeking their own Authorized Investigator status. Information about collaborators
:::

For more information about **approving sponsorships**, navigate [here](/managing-my-sponsored-researchers/approving-sponsorship.qmd).

For more information about **renewing sponsorships**, navigate [here](/managing-my-sponsored-researchers/renewing-sponsorship.qmd).

For more information about **removing sponsored researchers**, navigate [here](/managing-my-sponsored-researchers/removing-sponsorship.qmd).
